limitations: Intentional ordering change: ordinary matches precede OCR-only unpinned matches; therefore this is not output-equivalent to the prototype.
Wall times are store calls/publication, not keystroke-to-pixel or complete frame latency.
App-module fixture uses real AppCore and indexer in verified fresh sandbox; AppCore.start and global capture/services never run.
RSS and physical-footprint samples are phase snapshots, not measured recognition peaks or full normal-app memory deltas.
Apple framework memory remains after disabling a previously used feature; only cold disabled OCR initialization/work is avoided.
Raycast A/B recognition quality, rotation/low-quality corpus and normal app all-features budget remain unvalidated. One Japanese sample missed a glyph.
measurement_provenance: Search, dense-memory, quality, and three app aggregates originated in the working-tree build before isolating the PR on upstream 17ed8a1. Clipboard model/extractor/indexer source hashes are unchanged; unrelated AppCore and feature changes are excluded from this PR.
